diagnosis: The GetRequestDetails method queries maintenance tickets using sqlx without validating that the requesting tenant resides in the associated unit_id. A tenant in an apartment complex can view repair tickets, internal entry permission notes, and unit door access instructions of other residents.
exploit_request:
GET /leases/maintenance/maint_4021 HTTP/1.1
Host: resident.property-management.com
Authorization: Bearer tenant_jwt_unit4b
Accept: application/json
